title: Read a failure before fixing it
summary: A failure is evidence that actual and expected results differ. Check the requirement before changing either the code or the expected answer.
introduction: A failure is evidence that actual and expected results differ. Check the requirement before changing either the code or the expected answer. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain read a failure before fixing it
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A failure is evidence that actual and expected results differ. Check the requirement before changing either the code or the expected answer.

blocks.title: Read a failure before fixing it

blocks.text: The result has actual 4, expected 5 and passed false. Here the expected answer is wrong.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Write the correct expectation and explain why it is correct.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not change an expectation only to turn the test green.
For more detail later, use this [Unit Testing further reading](https://nodejs.org/api/test.html).
